translations.web: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,
translations.bsb: Women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ your women keep silence in the churches: for it is ➔ not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
translations.asv: let the women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but let them be in subjection, as also saith the law.
